ModMetaData.name: VGE Mechanoid Signal Fix
ModMetaData.author: Alik
ModMetaData.description:
Fixes the Mechanoid Signal quest from Vanilla Gravship Expanded without disabling it.
The original quest creates VGE Astropedes and Hunters during quest generation and deep-saves them inside an unspawned skyfaller. Loading those pawns before the game's FactionManager is ready can cause BackCompatibilityConverter and MechEnergy null-reference errors.
This patch keeps the quest, wrecked gravjumper, reward, mechanoid composition and threat scaling, but generates the mechanoids only when the wreck actually lands on the map.
